obligations.summary: High-risk AI systems trained and tested on data reflecting their specific intended geographical, behavioural, contextual, or functional setting are presumed to comply with the data governance requirements of Article 10(4).

High-risk AI systems certified or covered by a statement of conformity under an EU cybersecurity scheme (Regulation (EU) 2019/881) published in the Official Journal are presumed to comply with the cybersecurity requirements of Article 15, to the extent that the certificate or statement covers those requirements.
exceptions: Presumption applies only insofar as the cybersecurity certificate or statement of conformity, or parts thereof, actually cover the Article 15 cybersecurity requirements.
